text: Silogia is a Portuguese workplace-solutions company founded in 2004, born of experience in the office market over several years; its own site describes the business but names no shareholder or parent company.

source.name: Silogia, 'Sobre nós' (company description)
source.quote: Fundada em 2004, a Silogia é fruto da experiência adquirida no mercado de escritórios ao longo de vários anos.
